checks.evidence: comparison-summary.json records a hidden policy-envelope requirement: the verifier required an outer cases array, while the profile constrained values and order but did not name that key. Post-hoc normalization was not applied.
The arms were source-blind and profiles were byte-identical within each arm, but the task fixture was not fully equivalent to its exact oracle because the required policy envelope was undisclosed.

Both single sessions passed discovery, post-quarantine write, process, raw-disposal, and postflight gates. Both returned all six correct policy decisions, but exact combined-result qualification is blocked by P1; friction was exact in one of two rounds.

Both custom sessions passed child-before-quarantine and join-after-release gates, and each join exactly preserved both child results and identities. Exact product qualification is blocked by P1; friction was exact in zero of two rounds.

runtime-summary.json and comparison-summary.json record exact verification booleans, durations, exits, timeout state, result hashes, and declared session multiplicity without reading raw output or inferring token cost.
The result is classified inconclusive rather than choosing a winner or repairing scores post hoc. The valid friction subset and custom join fidelity are reported separately.
The frozen harness used ordinary custom agents only. Teamwork Preview, Puppet, Herdr, devices, browsers, and PR #6 were untouched.

All four rounds passed scoped postflight; raw artifacts were digested and unlinked unread. Five exact roots totaling 21 files and 236171 bytes were removed and verified absent after resolving only the two exact residual mode-fenced directories.

anti_cheat_probes.result: Semantically equivalent policy envelopes remain exact-verifier failures; the proof reports the oracle flaw instead of rewriting scores.
The parent received neither product packet nor hidden branch marker/path; each child received only its own product packet.
Both custom joins exactly preserved policy/friction values and both child identity-marker pairs after the OS gate released.
Each arm ran twice in fresh disposable workspaces with two fresh challenges and byte-identical profiles within the arm.
Discovery was digested in memory; stdout, stderr, and AGY logs were hashed and unlinked without content inspection.

blockers: The policy packet omitted the exact outer key required by the controller oracle.
Complete-result rates cannot fairly select a winning arm for this attempt.
The valid friction subset favored single 1/2 to custom 0/2, but two rounds are insufficient for a reusable product claim.
Width-four joining remains failed independently at Phase 3.
